Daily Quiz.question: ১) Even if you run, you’ll still be late. Here, “Even if” means-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Even if means ‘whether or not’:
Even if you run, you’ll still be late. (You’ll be late whether you run or not.)
I feel tired even if I go to bed early. (I feel tired whether I go to bed early or not.)

২) Choose the best option to replace the underlined word of the sentence.
Put your signature below the bottom of the page.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Back, bottom, end, front, top শব্দগুলোর সাথে at বসে। যেমন,
He shouted at the top of his voice.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) I know nothing regarding this matter. Here ‘regarding’ is a-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Regarding (PREPOSITION) In respect of; concerning.
‘your recent letter regarding the above proposal’

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) A determiner must _________.
Daily Quiz.exp: Determiner এর প্রধান কাজ Noun কে Determine করা। Noun এর নির্দিষ্টতা-অনির্দিষ্টতা বুঝাতে এটি ব্যবহার হয়। তবে তা noun কে আংশিক কিংবা পরিপূর্ণ ভাবে modify করলেও, modify করা এটির প্রধান কাজ নয়। তাই সঠিক উত্তর হিসেবে determine a noun কে ধরা হয়েছে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) We went for a walk ____ the rain.
Daily Quiz.exp: কোন কিছু সত্ত্বেও অর্থে in spite of/despite ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) He’s quite short, _______ his sister is tall.
Daily Quiz.exp:
The conjunctions but and although/though connect ideas that contrast. Whereas is also used but it is not as common:
The new city hall is amazing but it’s going to cost a lot.
He’s quite short, whereas his sister is tall.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) ______ the people who saw the exhibition thought it was marvelous.
Daily Quiz.exp: সম্পূর্ণ বাক্যটিঃ All the people who saw the exhibition thought it was marvelous.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) He lost his phone ______ the cinema hall.
Daily Quiz.exp: শূন্যস্থানে at বসবে। কিন্তু অপশন গুলোতে তা নেই। তাই none of these কে সঠিক উত্তর হিসেবে ধরা হয়েছে।

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Which one of the following is the correct meaning of ‘a few’?
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) Not many, but all there are
Daily Quiz.exp:
A few (adj) some, more than one but indefinitely small in number
“a few roses”

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) The taxi is due any minute. Can you listen out _______ it?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Listen out for sth [phrasal verb] to make an effort to hear a noise that you are expecting.
Would you listen out for the phone while I'm in the garden?

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) The girl ______ blue is my would be wife.
Daily Quiz.exp: পোশাক, রং, কালি ইত্যাদির পূর্বে in বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) I worked <u>as</u> a waiter when I was a student. Most of us did. The underlined word is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp:
As as a preposition:
We use as with a noun to refer to the role or purpose of a person or thing.
I worked as a waiter when I was a student. Most of us did.
We don’t use as + noun to mean ‘similar to’. We use like + noun:
It’s almost like a real beach, but it’s actually artificial.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Our flat is _____ the second floor of the building.
Daily Quiz.exp: কোন কিছু ছুঁয়ে থাকলে উপরে অর্থে on, ছুঁয়ে না থাকলে উপরে (গতিশীল) অর্থে over এবং অনেক উপরে অর্থে বা ঠিক উপরে অর্থে above হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) We were really surprised ______ the price of food in restaurants on our holiday.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Surprised (adjective) feeling or showing surprise because something has happened that you did not expect.
We were very surprised at the result.
It's not like you to behave like this, Alice - I'm surprised at you (= I feel disappointed with you)!

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) I didn’t have _______ luggage, just two small bags.
Daily Quiz.exp: Luggage শব্দটি uncountable noun এবং বাক্যটি negative হওয়ায় শূন্যস্থানে much বসবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) He went to bed _______ he was tired.
Daily Quiz.exp: বাক্যের অর্থ ঠিক রাখতে শূন্যস্থানে because বসবে। বাক্যটির অর্থ- তিনি বিছানায় গেলেন, কারণ তিনি ক্লান্ত ছিলেন।

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) We’re not happy but we do approve _____ their decision.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Approve of sb/sth- to have a good opinion of someone or something.
Close to 90% of people approve of his handling of the crisis.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) We’re really excited ______ our trip to Argentina.
Daily Quiz.exp: Excited (adjective) She was excited about the trip because she was going to learn to ski.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) The weather was cold _____ clear.
Daily Quiz.exp:
but যোগে বাক্যটির অর্থ পরিপূর্ণ হয়। The weather was cold but clear অর্থ- আবহাওয়া ঠান্ডা তবে পরিষ্কার ছিল।
Source: Oxford Dictionary.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) The country is now _______ martial law.
Daily Quiz.exp:
Under: Used to say who or what controls, governs or manages somebody/something.
The country is now under martial law.
The mission is under United Nations control.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) They knocked down all the houses _______ they built a car park.
Daily Quiz.exp: শূন্যস্থানের পূর্বের এবং পরের দুটো বাক্যকে যুক্ত করতে conjunction হিসেবে and বসবে।

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) London lies ______ the thames.
Daily Quiz.exp: দিক নির্ণয়ের ক্ষেত্রে সীমার ভিতরে অর্থে in; সীমার উপর বা বরাবর অর্থে on এবং সীমার বাইরে অর্থে to বসে।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) _______ he pays a fine, he will not have to go to jail.
Daily Quiz.exp: শর্ত বুঝাতে Provided/Provided that (যদি) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question:
২৪) Find out the missing Article from the following sentence.
I hope we have nice weather.
Daily Quiz.exp:
We don’t use a/an before uncountable nouns:
Correct: Could I have rice instead of potatoes with my fish?
Incorrect: Could I have a rice.
Correct: I hope we have nice weather.
Incorrect: I hope we have a nice weather.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) Ugh, sorry, I can’t eat tomatoes. Here, “Ugh” is a/an-
Daily Quiz.exp:
We use interjections to express emotions such as pleasure, surprise, shock and disgust. Most interjections are just sounds, rather than actual words, and come at the beginning or at the end of what we say. Interjections are more common in speaking than in writing:
Ouch, it stings. (expresses pain)
You’re going to the Maldives. That’s a long way, wow. (expresses surprise and wonder)
Hooray, here comes the bus at last! (expresses delight)
Ugh, sorry, I can’t eat tomatoes. (expresses disgust)

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) The money was divided not ________ his two sons only but ______ all his sons and daughters.
Daily Quiz.exp: দুইয়ের মধ্যে সম্পর্ক বোঝাতে - between এবং দুইয়ের অধিকের ক্ষেত্রে among ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) ______ Pohela Boishakh, there is a festive mood all _______ the country.
Daily Quiz.exp: কোন নির্দিষ্ট দিন বা তারিখের সাথে on বসে। যেমন, On Monday, On Pohela Boishakh.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) The short expression like Oh, Um, Ah, Hey, Well, Ouch is known as-
Daily Quiz.exp: Interjection is a big name for a little word. Interjections are short exclamations like Oh, Um, Ah, Hey, Well, Ouch! They have no real grammatical value but we use them quite often, usually more in speaking than in writing.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) The basket is made ______ bamboo.
Daily Quiz.exp: কোনো কিছু তৈরির পর উপাদান দেখা গেলে made of বসবে। কিন্তু কোনো কিছু তৈরির পর উপাদান দেখা না গেলে made from বসবে।

Daily Quiz.question:
৩০) In what way we can connect the following two sentences.
1) He couldn’t get money from the bank.
2) He couldn’t buy a house.
Daily Quiz.option1: ক) He couldn’t get money from the bank so he couldn’t buy a house.
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) He couldn’t get money from the bank. As a result he couldn’t buy a house.
Daily Quiz.option3: গ) He couldn’t get money from the bank. He couldn’t buy a house as a result.
Daily Quiz.exp:
''So'' makes a subordinating link between the cause/reason (He couldn’t get money from the bank) and the result (he couldn’t buy a house). This is a grammatical link. The position of so cannot change.
''As a result'' creates a link between two clauses based on meaning. We can move as a result.
He couldn’t get money from the bank. As a result he couldn’t buy a house.
He couldn’t get money from the bank. He couldn’t buy a house as a result.
